title: Catholic Academic Exchange Service (KAAD): Scholarship Programme 1
summary: KAAD Scholarship Programme 1 supports post-graduates and academics with work experience from Africa, Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America to pursue Master's, PhD, or research stays in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Master's degree, PhD, post-doctoral studies (excluded from student award track), or research project.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are generally eligible as no subject restrictions are mentioned.

nationality.notes: Open to applicants from countries in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or Latin America.

residence.notes: Must currently reside in a country in Africa, Asia, the Middle East or Latin America.

mandatory.text: Catholic denomination (or another Christian denomination if from the Middle East, or proposed by a Catholic partner organisation with willingness for inter-religious dialogue)
completed university education and work experience in home country
focus on permanent reintegration in home country
socially engaged and involved in the Church
German language knowledge prior to stay at least on level B1 (or at least level A2 for English language courses of study)

exceptions.text: Candidates from non-partner countries will be eligible only as an exception.
Non-Christian candidates are eligible if recommended by local churches.

funding.description: Exact base student stipend amounts not numerically specified on this page.

application_rounds.notes: The individual partner committees set their own deadlines.

recurring_deadline_notes: The individual partner committees set their own deadlines.

steps.text: Applications are submitted to the partner committees in the candidates' home countries.

sources.title: Catholic Academic Exchange Service (KAAD): Scholarship Programme 1 - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme supports international students and researchers for post-graduate studies and research projects at a higher-education institution in Germany.
